meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 将应用部署到 Vercel 并管理项目配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将前端应用部署到 Vercel 平台
copy.tagline_en: Deploy apps to Vercel and manage project settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy frontend apps to Vercel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你将网页应用部署到 Vercel，管理项目、域名和环境变量，并在分享前自动检查部署是否成功。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布或管理 Vercel 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会运行构建并执行部署命令。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录。
say.note: Claude 会调用 vercel ls 命令。

say.text: 给当前项目添加一个域名 example.com。
say.note: Claude 会执行 vercel domains add。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel, manage projects, domains, and environment variables, and verify deployment success before sharing the URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will run build and deploy commands.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will run vercel domains add.
